shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books in the park.
My favorite season is autumn because of the colors.
I like to cook new recipes on weekends.
Traveling to new places is always an adventure.
Hiking helps me relax and appreciate nature.
I often listen to music while studying for exams.
Gardening has become my new favorite hobby this year.
Spending time with friends makes my weekends special.
I try to exercise regularly to stay healthy and fit.
Volunteering at the local animal shelter brings me joy.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eating habits.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your typical daily meals?
Q2: What challenges do you face when trying to eat healthy?
Q3: How important do you think eating habits are for overall well-being?
Q4: What advice would you give someone trying to improve their eating habits?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about study methods.
questions: Q1: What study techniques do you use to prepare for exams?
Q2: Have you encountered any difficulties while studying?
Q3: In your opinion, what is the most effective study method?
Q4: What tips would you offer to someone struggling with their studies?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: Can you share your favorite travel destination and why?
Q2: What challenges do you face when planning a trip?

Q4: What recommendations would you give for someone planning their first trip?
